tees.title: The Flower That Waited Tee
tees.manifestation: What is meant for me is already approaching.
tees.story: A single bud reaches towards a circle of gold, holding the promise of a bloom still to come. It honours the daughters whose dreams quietly grow into possibilities for others.

tees.title: Roots Before Roses Tee
tees.story: A red rose rises above a branching network of roots. It honours the often unseen strength of India's daughters, whose resolve sustains families, communities and generations of growth.

tees.title: The Quiet Garden Tee
tees.manifestation: Peace is the highest form of wealth.
tees.story: A small blue flower rests among deep green leaves, bringing quiet colour to the canvas. It celebrates the daughters whose thoughtful presence gives others space to flourish.

tees.title: Sunflower After Midnight Tee
tees.manifestation: My light remains mine, even in darkness.
tees.story: A golden sunflower bows against a midnight sky, its colour undimmed by the darkness. It honours the daughters who carry hope through difficult seasons and illuminate the lives around them.

tees.title: A Door Made of Petals Tee
tees.manifestation: Beauty opens the life I am ready to enter.
tees.story: Two sweeping petals frame an open passage, turning a delicate bloom into a doorway. It celebrates the daughters who open new paths through creativity, courage and the freedom to imagine.

tees.title: Inherited Spring Tee
tees.manifestation: I turn what I receive into something that blooms.
tees.story: A young stem rises from a small root ball, crowned by a vivid red petal. It honours the daughters who carry their inheritance forward, making room for a spring of their own.

tees.title: Garden of One Hundred Tee
tees.manifestation: Rarity is a way of living deliberately.
tees.story: A layered blush bloom unfolds with a character entirely its own. It celebrates the individuality of India's daughters, each bringing a distinct voice, gift and way of seeing to the world.

tees.title: Water Remembers the Lotus Tee
tees.manifestation: I rise without carrying the weight of where I began.
tees.story: A pale lotus opens above still water, its reflection resting beneath it. It honours the daughters who rise beyond circumstance with grace, creating possibilities that reach far beyond their beginnings.

tees.title: The Garden Kept a Secret Tee
tees.manifestation: Mystery protects what is still becoming.
tees.story: A pale leaf partly shelters a dark bloom, revealing beauty without revealing everything. It celebrates the inner worlds of India's daughters and the dreams they choose to nurture in their own time.

tees.title: Home Is the First Kingdom Tee
tees.manifestation: Abundance begins in the love that surrounds me.
tees.story: Golden flowers curve towards one another around a smaller central bloom. It honours the daughters whose love helps shape our first sense of belonging, and whose influence reaches well beyond home.

tees.title: The Rose After the Sirens Tee
tees.manifestation: What was broken can still become beautiful.
tees.story: A red rose stands above fallen petals and a wash of blue, holding its colour amid the fragments. It honours the daughters whose resilience makes space for beauty and renewal after hardship.

tees.title: Seeds Kept in a Teacup Tee
tees.manifestation: I carry tomorrow in the smallest things.
tees.story: Tender seedlings emerge from a porcelain teacup, finding a home in something small and familiar. It celebrates the daughters whose everyday acts of care nurture futures larger than the moment.

tees.title: The Orchard Learned Our Names Tee
tees.manifestation: What we rebuild will remember our care.
tees.story: A fruit-bearing branch stretches across a soft, open sky, carrying both blossom and harvest. It honours the daughters whose patient work nourishes communities and leaves a living legacy for those who follow.

tees.title: Jasmine Returned to the Window Tee
tees.story: White jasmine grows around a weathered window frame, bringing life to its edges. It celebrates the daughters whose tenderness restores belonging, wherever they build a home in the world.

tees.title: The Last Watering Can Tee
tees.manifestation: Even one careful act can call life forward.
tees.story: A golden drop falls from a watering can towards a lone flower in dry earth. It honours the daughters whose smallest acts of care can sustain life and begin lasting change.
